style: src/ssc/plotstyle.py (Times New Roman, 300 dpi, drawn at 6.27 in)

conventions.nines_axis: AUC x drawn at -log10(1 - x); exact 1.0 drawn at 1 - 1e-5 and labelled '= 1', with an axis break between 0.9999 and the cap (F3, F5a; checked: no plotted value lies between the break and 1); in F4 the main axis ends at 0.9993 and folds at exactly 1 are counted in a separate column (bar = share of the 100 folds)
conventions.reference_lines: every reference value (0, 0.5, 1.5, 0.947, 0.99, 0.999, 0.806) is a 0.6 pt dashed line
conventions.F1a: Pearson correlation of the 150 features over the 20,000 train+test rows; drawn: the 20 structured features, informative [6, 15, 30, 46, 52, 61, 64, 80, 100, 112, 142, 144] then redundant [8, 17, 26, 49, 57, 67, 77, 98] (roles as inferred under make_classification), diagonal left blank; the 130 noise features are only a note (max |r| among them: core_data.md)
conventions.F1b: sd over the 20,000 rows divided by the median sd of the 150 features; block = ratio > 1.5
conventions.F1c: block standardised with train+test mean and sd, reduced to its rank-12 span; every row weighted by p (test rows: S003's archived score; training rows: their label) and by 1 - p; weighted means and covariances; generalised eigenvectors of (p-weighted, (1-p)-weighted) covariance; axes = the directions with the largest and the smallest variance ratio, scaled to unit (1-p)-weighted sd, origin at the (1-p)-weighted mean; ellipses = 1 sd (dashed) and 2 sd (solid) of each weighted class; limits = 99.9% quantile of |coordinate| x 1.02 per axis (rows outside: core_data.md); the panel is not equal-aspect: x is squeezed relative to y by the factor printed in the panel; rows with 0.1 < p < 0.9 are drawn last and larger
conventions.F2a: E1 paired difference (model A corr top-30 + L2 minus model B corr top-50 + L2) per execution, 50 executions (split seeds) per scheme; outline = Gaussian kernel density (Scott), scaled to equal peak height, drawn where it exceeds 1% of its peak; fill grey by fits per decision; ink bar = +-MDD, MDD = 2 sd of the 50 differences (E1 paired_difference.csv); ticks = the 50 estimates; grey band = pooled 5 x 20 mean +- 0.01 (as in E1's figure)
conventions.F2bc: R900: mean AUC over 100 folds (5 x 20, seed 2026) for each of 20 label permutations; Null A trained and scored on permuted labels, its folds stratified on the permuted labels (so not the official folds); Null B trained on permuted labels on the official folds and scored on the true ones; one x scale for both; black tick = mean over the 20 permutations; controls drawn as x (the leaky filter and the label reader should fire, random scores should not), red only where the control fires (leaky filter in A, label reader in B)
conventions.F3_public_se: Hanley-McNeil at the pre-registered expected AUC, 198 pos / 197 neg (as R440); bars that reach 1 stop below the axis break with a caret; arrows: expectation -> public score, and (red) E3 leaky CV -> S004 public score
conventions.F4: fold_scores.csv of each run (100 official folds, split signature 5708ce5c3828); dots = folds with AUC < 1 (jitter +-0.32 row); tick = CV mean (S005's 0.9999 is beyond the main axis: marker at its end); right column: number of folds with AUC exactly 1 (bar length = share of 100)
conventions.F5a: R441 label_budget_evals.csv: mean and 10%/90% quantiles over 400 evaluations (80 folds x 5 label draws; 80 at n = 200), only budgets where every evaluation is defined; first hit = smallest such budget with mean >= 0.99 (equals R441 label_budget_first_hit.csv), ringed on the curve, its x tick in bold; S005's band hatched (no fill) so that it reads where it overlaps Bayesian QDA's
conventions.F5b: R404 boundary rows (true class probability in (0.1, 0.9)), clean labels, 222 replicas; dot = mean; dark bar = +-2 MC SE of the mean; light bar = +-1 sd across replicas (= MC SE x sqrt(222), R404 computes the MC SE as sd/sqrt(n)); per-replica values are not archived; hollow = in-fold (labels-only) Bayesian QDA; 222/222 = R404 bnd_auc_clean_share_s003_better = 1 for every other procedure
conventions.F6a: R936 primary convention: group tn0 (clean training labels), csv8 scores, levels 0/0.0025/0.005/0.01 weighted 0.0773/0.4069/0.3608/0.1550 (R156); dots = per-replica mean difference over the 16 draws; outline = weighted kernel density (bandwidth factor 0.15) of all replica x draw differences, drawn within the data range where it exceeds 1.2% of its peak; P(beats S003) over replica x draw splits; recomputed from the archived npz and equal to R936 private.csv; ext.-grid QDA (r930) is a post-hoc variant, drawn last, dashed, below a divider
conventions.F6b: R922 flat prior on flip_y in [0, 0.1]: weights Ltrain_rel x Lpub_conv_exact_round5 mapped to the nearest simulated level; within a level normal(mean, sd) of R922's private_by_flip.csv (draws not archived); reproduces R922's mean, quantiles and P(>= 0.999) (core_predictive.csv); printed numbers are R922's archived ones; bars stacked by noise level (5 groups, each labelled by the lowest and highest simulated level inside it), the bars at or above 0.999 outlined (their total = P(>= 0.999)); strip above: median and 90% interval
